candidates.requirement: Exercise parser_free with an unattached saved comment after a parse error.
candidates.target_route: Create a parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS, parse /*x*/}, then free the parser after the error.
candidates.failure_condition: The old target creates the parser with flags 0 and returns on error before calling parser_free, so no input exercises the new last_comment cleanup.
candidates.alternative_paths: Successful parses attach a pending comment before cleanup; the target has no other parser setup or free call.

candidates.requirement: Release each created parser when parsing reports an error.
candidates.target_route: Supply the one-byte input {; add_string reaches the UCL state machine, which reports an unmatched opening brace; get_error is non-NULL.
candidates.failure_condition: The target returns on a non-NULL error without calling parser_free, leaving the parser allocated.
candidates.alternative_paths: The only parser_free call follows the error return; there is no cleanup on that branch.
